admission_sweep_gate.question: Does any selected ordinary L2 sequencer admit the complete deterministic 80-210 KiB transaction range?
admission_sweep_gate.reason: Every selected ordinary sequencer source-proven byte limit rejects the generated 210 KiB signed transactions; no selected network supports the complete range.

SP71_product_gate.question: Does the selected route reduce user cost by at least 90% while preserving application semantics?
blockers: Required Ethereum local/testnet, OP-family testnet, and Arbitrum-family testnet measurements are absent.

decision: Retain the ordinary 210 KiB size rejection, but do not mark SP-71 passed or complete. Required network measurements and product-gate evidence remain unavailable; any chunked or non-ordinary route requires separate design and faithful reproduction.
prohibitions: Do not describe projected admission as a receipt.
